title: Pearson Edexcel International GCSE English Language A (4EA1) — Paper 1

authority.file: MSR/EDEXCEL IGCSE English Language Component A/Mark Scheme for Edexcel IGCSE English Language Component A P1/4ea1-01-rms-20220825.pdf
authority.why_this_source: The board's own published mark scheme — the top of the authority order (PEDAGOGY.md, Neil 2026-08-16). This is the paper whose tariffs our protocol got wrong: it marked Q2 out of 3 (real 4) and Q3 out of 6 (real 5) from 2026-04-08 until 2026-08-17, four months live. This file exists so that cannot recur silently.
authority.note_on_wording: Question WORDING rotates between sittings (June 2022 Q2 asks thoughts/feelings; June 2024 asks 'in your own words describe what happens'). TARIFFS AND OBJECTIVES DO NOT. Never key a protocol on one paper's wording.

total.why: The mark scheme never states the paper total — it states each question's tariff. 90 is the sum of the six quoted questions (check C), cross-checked against language-paper-specs.json (check D).

questions.quote: Writing assessment grids for Questions 6 and 7
questions.note: Section B: the candidate answers ONE of Q6/Q7; both are marked on the same two grids.
questions.why_no_marks_quote: The mark scheme gives Section B as two grids (AO4 max 27, AO5 max 18) and never prints 45. It is the sum of two quoted maxima.
questions.protocol_note: The protocol heads this 'Assessment Sub-Protocol: Section B (AO4/AO5 – 45 Marks)' — the tariff IS stated (45) and matches the board; check E keys on 'Question N' headings so it cannot see a section-named one. Verified by hand 2026-08-18.

protocols.role: Section B (Q6/Q7) — headed 'Assessment Sub-Protocol: Section B (AO4/AO5 – 45 Marks)', not 'Question 6', which is why check E reported it unverified
